newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish Riksbank board meeting ends, no changes.
newsitem.headline: Swedish Riksbank board meeting ends, no changes.

text.p: The Swedish central bank board's regular meeting ended on Thursday with no interest rate changes announced.
The bank's key interest rate, the repo, currently stands at 4.10 percent.
Its other key rates, the deposit and lending rates, which mark its interest rate corridor, stand at 3.75 percent and 5.25 percent, respectively.
The Riksbank board will next have a telephone meeting on February 13 at 0800 GMT.
